data.name: Railhold
data.detailed_description:
The wasteland is overrun, and the railway is your only way through.

Railhold is a top-down action roguelite tower defense built around an armored train. Add new wagons, mount weapons and put together a crew capable of keeping the train alive as enemies attack from every direction.

Most battles happen while the train is moving. Your defenses need to cover the entire convoy, and every wagon you add creates something new that must be protected. Place turrets on available hardpoints, upgrade important systems and use commander abilities when your defenses begin to buckle.

Stations give you a moment to repair, reorganize and prepare for what lies further down the line. Resources are limited, so you will have to decide which parts of the train are worth improving and which weaknesses you can afford to leave exposed.

Every run gives you different upgrades, encounters and opportunities to shape your convoy. Experiment with weapon combinations, recruit crew with useful abilities and adapt your strategy before the next horde—or something much larger—reaches the tracks.

Features:

  • Build and expand your own armored train

  • Defend the convoy during real-time battles

  • Mount, upgrade and combine different turret types and form over 45 different turret synergies. 

  • Recruit crew members to operate and strengthen the train

  • Make repairs and difficult upgrade choices at stations

  • Face increasingly dangerous mutants and massive bosses

  • Discover new builds through replayable roguelite runs

  • Keep the train moving for as long as you can

Build the train. Hold the line. Keep moving.

data.short_description: Build an armored train and defend it against relentless mutant hordes. Mount turrets, recruit crew and make every stop count in a top-down roguelite tower defense where your base never stops moving.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: OpenGL 3.3-compatible graphics required. Estimated for 1280×720 gameplay.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3 GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Estimated for 1920×1080 gameplay.
